notes: Right-hand page of spread 344-345. Golari or Holia: only Males/Females (cols 93-94) on this page; Persons (col 92) is on leaf 354, so records here carry persons = null. Header: '(ii) Dravidian family-concld.' over cols 93-103; 'A.-Vernaculars of India-(iii) Austric family (Austro-Asiatic sub-family) Munda branch' over cols 104-109. The serial-number column is misregistered (about half a row) against the data; in the States block rows were fixed by measuring the vertical pitch of the nil-dot rows in a clean column and matching each figure to it, then confirmed by totals. Page foot carries signature mark '90'.
